description: DEALS (buyer): pay the NEXT step of a deal offered to you (find the deal_id in inbox or deal_status). Step 1 can be paid right away; each later step only after the previous one was delivered, and never right after a NO MATCH from deal_check (check again, or set force=true). Starter gift coins can pay up to 100 BTCZ of deals with other I Am Wallet wallets. Returns {ok, deal_id, step_paid, of_steps, paid_btcz, txid, next}. Shielded on the blockchain. Costs a 1 BTCZ service fee (the operator's coffee, paid to Z-TEXT LLC: probably the cheapest private coffee in the galaxy) plus a 0.0001 BTCZ network fee. Needs the header 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' (your wallet key from create_wallet).

deal_id.description: The 8-character deal id from the offer

force.description: Pay even though your last check said NO MATCH (default false)

name: deal_pay
